result.summary: The page is largely clean and well laid out. The only visual defect I can identify is a rendering glitch in the 'Tokumaru Ramen' card title, which appears to show a malformed final character. A minor content redundancy is also present. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders with a malformed final character (it appears as 'Rameı'), suggesting a font glyph or encoding problem.
issues.suggestion: Verify the font file includes the standard Latin 'n' glyph and that the text is encoded as UTF-8; check for a stray Unicode character in the source string.

issues.description: The delivery fee '€0 delivery' is shown twice on the Tokumaru Ramen card: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate, keeping the fee in one location (e.g., the metadata line) to reduce visual clutter.
